prs.title: fix: propagate SSE stream errors to waiting requests
prs.author: heyhayes
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Tool calls hang forever when the streamable-http connection fails — errors are not propagated back to waiting callers, leaving them suspended indefinitely. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Tool calls hang forever when the streamable-http connection fails — errors are not propagated back to waiting callers, leaving them suspended indefinitely. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2122 targets the SSE stream path (the primary channel for server-pushed events in streamable-http) and propagates stream errors to all waiting requests, while also bumping MAX_RECONNECTION_ATTEMPTS from 2→5 for resilience and adding exception logging in the default message handler. PR #1578 covers only the POST request path with a similar error-propagation approach but leaves the SSE path unaddressed and has a narrower scope. #2122's fix is broader in coverage; the POST-path gap from #1578 could be addressed as a follow-up if needed.

prs.title: Handle BrokenResourceError in stdio client shutdown path
prs.author: aframedelta
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: BrokenResourceError unhandled during stdio client shutdown: both stdout_reader and stdin_writer only caught ClosedResourceError, missing the BrokenResourceError that can occur in a race between stream teardown and I/O completion. Both PRs apply the identical two-line fix to stdio.py. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: BrokenResourceError unhandled during stdio client shutdown: both stdout_reader and stdin_writer only caught ClosedResourceError, missing the BrokenResourceError that can occur in a race between stream teardown and I/O completion. prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2143 was opened first and contains the same source fix. clusters.pick_reason: PR #2122 targets the SSE stream path (the primary channel for server-pushed events in streamable-http) and propagates stream errors to all waiting requests, while also bumping MAX_RECONNECTION_ATTEMPTS from 2→5 for resilience and adding exception logging in the default message handler. PR #1578 covers only the POST request path with a similar error-propagation approach but leaves the SSE path unaddressed and has a narrower scope. #2122's fix is broader in coverage; the POST-path gap from #1578 could be addressed as a follow-up if needed.
